subject: NorthCentra outage & cross-region failover — executive debrief
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@northcentra.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, support@redwood.ai
Cc: NorthCentra SRE Team <sre@northcentra.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production errors spike in us-west-2 — immediate help required

Rishi / Redwood support,

We started seeing a spike in 500s and token latency around 07:40 PST that impacted multiple services (generation & embedding endpoints) for NorthCentra. Our ingress logs show sustained 35-40% error rates and some requests timing out at the client for >8s. We've been routing to your us-west-2 region. Can you confirm if there was a regional outage or throttling event?

I've attached a small packet of logs and a screenshot of the errors. This is impacting our customers on the east coast and Europe via our own routing layer. Please escalate — our SREs are standing by.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Production, NorthCentra
jordan.blake@northcentra.com
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Production errors spike in us-west-2 — immediate help required

Thanks Jordan — and sorry for the disruption. Evelyn, can you and Sean take point on a customer-facing triage? Naomi / Markus please pull up routing and capacity dashboards (us-west-2) and confirm whether there were AZ evictions or scheduler activity.

Action items for now:
- Evelyn/Sean: quick post to Jordan with current mitigation steps and ETA.
- Naomi: confirm if any Dedicated pools were rescheduled in the last 2 hours.
- Markus: check autoscaler decision logs and any cross-region routing policy flips.

I will loop in Grace (CS) for exec comms if this looks like a multi-hour SLA impact.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@northcentra.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, NorthCentra SRE Team <sre@northcentra.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 08:39:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production errors spike in us-west-2 — immediate help required

Jordan — thanks for the logs. Quick summary from our side:
- We observed an AZ pair (us-west-2b) reporting elevated OOM/eviction rates on a subset of Dedicated hosts which triggered a transient imbalance across the GPU pool.
- Autoscaler attempted to rebalance; during that window a small fraction (~12%) of requests were routed to a degraded model variant which increases token latency and can raise 5xxs under high concurrency.

Immediate mitigation performed at 08:30 PST:
- Forced drain on the affected hosts and pinned live traffic away from us-west-2b to healthy AZs within us-west-2.
- Manual routing policy applied to prioritize low-latency nodes; initiating cross-region diversion to us-east-1 for a subset of critical routes.

We will keep NorthCentra updated on rollout and will provide an exec summary in 90 minutes.

Evelyn Hart
Incident Lead, Redwood Inference
From: sean_gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@northcentra.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@cloudops.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production errors spike in us-west-2 — immediate help required

Follow-up tech notes:
- Autoscaler logs show repeated allocation failures for quantized instance types between 07:35–08:10. Cause: a kernel OOM pattern on a model variant combination under sustained 1.2k concurrent requests.
- We initiated partial cross-region failover at 08:32. Approximately 28% of NC traffic shifted to us-east-1 with steady success rates; remaining traffic was spread across healthy nodes in us-west-2a.
- Persistent 5xx traces are tied to requests that hit the degraded variant during the brief rebalance window.

Next steps:
1) Backfill cache + warm KV for hot prefixes before routing more traffic to us-east-1 to reduce cold-start latency.
2) Provision a temporary uplift on dedicated pool for NorthCentra if they request committed capacity while we stabilize.

—Sean
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>

Rishi / Grace — customer update drafted and sent at 12:05 PST. Summary: we acknowledged impact, explained autoscaler/variant degradation, and documented mitigation (routing + warmup). Jordan asked for an SLA exception note and a timeline for post-incident RCA. Grace, can you coordinate a short exec note and proposed credit for NorthCentra? Jordan indicated they may ask for a 10–15% usage credit if the outage spans multiple hours.

Attached: sla-exception-request.docx (draft).

Naomi Feldman
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@northcentra.com>, NorthCentra SRE Team <sre@northcentra.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, evelyn_hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 16:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Post-incident update & exec next steps — NorthCentra impact window 07:40–09:10 PST

Jordan — quick executive summary and next steps: the primary impact window was 07:40–09:10 PST on 14 Dec. Root cause: a combination of a quantized model kernel OOM under high concurrency and an autoscaler rebalance that routed a minority of traffic to a degraded variant during host eviction. Consequences: latency spikes for long-tail prefixes and ~30% observed error increase for affected tenants prior to full failover.

Commitments:
- We will deliver a full RCA by EOD Friday (2026-12-18) with logs, tracing spans, and a mitigations timeline.
- Short-term: schedule a targeted warm-cache migration and validate autoscaler policies to avoid the exact allocation pattern.
- Compensation: Grace will propose a tailored credit; Naomi already circulated a draft SLA exception.

If NorthCentra would like an immediate dedicated uplift, we can queue that for approval — estimated completion in 4 hours once accepted. Please let us know preference.

Thanks again for the rapid coordination.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
